player_prompt.intro:
Mauya kwenyu Frozen Lake!

Munhu wako unowakilwa na 'P' kwenyu grid.
Mifano ya grid:
  ' ' = Usevi wenjalo (unopitika)
  'H' = Shoko (ukapona unachema!)
  'G' = Mwisho (ukafika unowina!)
  'P' = Mahali akuno

Mabatiro anopinduka: kuwanda, kuchemera, kushanda, kuwanda (kana w, a, s, d)
Tumia batiro rakho kama: [up], [down], [left], [right] kana [w], [a], [s], [d]

Chipo: Enda kubva pano (kwemazano) kudai kwenyu mwisho (kumadokero) usisapote!

invalid_move.unknown_action: Chiito chisingazivikanwi '{action}'. Shandisa kumusoro, pasi, kuruboshwe, kurudyi kana w, a, s, d.

outcome.fell_in_hole: You fell into a hole! Game over. You completed {pct}% of the journey to the goal.
outcome.turn_limit: Wasvika pamuganhu wekutendeuka! Mutambo wapera. Wapedza {pct}% yerwendo kuenda kunangwa.
